claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_condition_immunity
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Heroism grants blanket immunity to the Frightened condition for the spell's duration. The existing apply_condition and remove_condition atoms are per-instance transitions, not persistent immunity grants. No v4 atom covers granting condition immunity as a durable ongoing state.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the creature is immune to the Frightened condition

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_temporary_hit_points
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Heroism grants THP equal to the caster's spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of the target's turns. THP is mechanically distinct from healing: THP and HP are separate pools, THP don't stack, and THP expire when the effect ends. The existing heal atom covers actual HP restoration, not THP grants. A separate atom is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns

claude_proposed_widenings.name: per_turn_grant variant of OngoingOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The THP grant fires at the target's turn_start_window, recurring each turn for the spell's duration. This is a new operation shape — a recurring per-turn trigger — not a roll modifier (RollModifierOperation) nor an on-hit rider (DamageOnHitOperation). The current OngoingOperation union cannot express it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns

claude_proposed_widenings.name: multi-operation support in OngoingEffectMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Heroism applies two simultaneous ongoing effects to the same target: condition immunity and per-turn THP. The current OngoingEffectMechanics family has a single operation field. Encoding both effects requires either an array of operations or a compound operation variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the creature is immune to the Frightened condition and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns
